# Colab only. Deliberately NOT pinned against torch/torchvision/numpy.
#
# The Colab image is the environment, and it moves: as of 2026-09 it ships Python 3.14 and
# torch 2.11+cu128. Pinning torch==2.5.1 / torchvision==0.20.1 made pip refuse the WHOLE
# requirement set - one unresolvable line aborts the resolution, so nothing at all was
# installed. Worse, forcing numpy or torch versions onto the image breaks CUDA.
#
# So: install only what the image lacks, and let `runlog` record the versions that were
# actually used (env/pip_freeze.txt + manifest.json in every run directory).
# Reproducibility here comes from the run record, not from a lock the platform rejects.

onnx
onnxruntime
ultralytics
